name: Baltimore Hood RP
description:
Run with your crew. Make money. Lose the cops.

Baltimore Hood RP is an open-world crime roleplay game set across Baltimore-inspired rowhouse blocks, housing courts and the Inner Harbor. Create your character, link up with friends and choose how you make a living.

• Rob stores, take illegal jobs and trade with other players.
• Drive across the city, refuel and spend your earnings on clothes and supplies.
• Rent a furnished home, invite friends over and throw a house party.
• Work legal jobs, become a barber, patrol as a cop or answer calls as a paramedic.
• Get arrested, serve your time, arrange bail or attempt an escape.

ALPHA — the city is still growing. Expect bugs and updates. Open GUIDE for controls and directions.
